The logo blur is also significant; it lacks the crisp edges of a printed label, appearing 'painted on' or melted. The Router did not miss any major structural defects. The `fine_grained_classifier` strongly confirms the class (logit 7.91 vs 4.07 for next best), supporting high alignment despite the missing tweeter feature.
